title: Selected single command
purpose: Cover the canonical single-command TypeID with a valid I-format frame and distinguish command selection semantics through the command qualifier.
expected_behavior: The peer parses an I-format C_SC_NA_1 command with TypeID 45, one object, activation cause, common address 1, information object address 1, and a single-command qualifier carrying the select bit.
constraints_preserved: Length 0x0e matches four control bytes and a ten-byte ASDU
Command qualifier is the final field after the three-byte information object address
issue_safety_notes: PK-only structural analogue using a normal selected command; it does not reproduce a historical exploit payload or claim a vulnerability.
